full_page.content:
c. 1903
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 9
Pg. 22 Nov. 29 1st of Advent (N. Yr. ) Penance the primary end of the Minor Friar - therefore a vocation to same implies first of all - penance - and whatever is of pain or death must be received at least with resignation - better with gratitude. - what does well that for which it was in- tended will be valued - otherwise neglected. If the Creator desires or requires penance, what better can the creature do? Deo Gratias!
Retreat Dec. 1903 Think of death every night after going to bed.
Pg. 23
Retr. Before Ordination
"The lion-king of the forest excepting himself. The chaste man, king of this world & master of himself."
St. Romoald's Vocation, by a 40 days penance for a murder by his Father in a duel.
Feb. 1 St. Brigid bn. in (Ulster) Fochard 453 AD. Her prayer for deformity is heard until she receives her snow-white veil when her former beauty returns.
Pg. 24 Communion for sick & children, Emmanual for Feb. 1907
Address of Br. Francis Commissariat of Holy Land Mt. St. Sepulchre Washington, D.C.
